## G — Definition of done (sec05-vision-health)
G01 domains covered: Section 5 vision-health scope — health responsibility, 11 MAB categories, vision standard, mental health tips, medications, FAE forms, driver review.
G02 passing standard exact: official quiz threshold is product policy from LearningLoop; official exam passing percent authored in part A only.
G03 high-yield ranked: vision standard, HCP reporting duty, FAE flow, review triggers and outcomes ranked in part C sibling.
G04 misconceptions: HCP role, vision retest rules, review does not equal withdrawal, privilege withdrawal conditions in part C sibling.
G05 mnemonics: memory aids for 11 categories and review triggers held as teaching knowledge in part C sibling.
G06 glossary: HCP, MAB, FAE, CVE, driver review, restrictions defined in plain language in part C sibling.
G07 dynamic isolated: pages 20-22 contain stable handbook rules; no officeholder or fee schedule isolated to updatable.
G08 competitive teardown: scoped out of this section chunk; dossier-level E2 teardown applies.
G09 market pack: scoped out of this section chunk; dossier-level E market pack applies.
G10 accuracy sourced: every sec05 rule page-anchored to printed pp.20-22; low-confidence items routed in part D sibling.
G11 verify list consolidated: sec05 open checks consolidated in part F sibling; no unchecked box counts as done.
